title: Efficiency of QuEChERS approach for determining 52 pesticide residues in honey and honey bees
author: Calatayud-Vernich, Calatayud, et al.

steps.title: QuEChERS: Sample preparation
steps.instruction: Weigh 5 g of honey or honey bees into a 50 mL centrifuge tube, add 7.5 mL water, 10 mL acetonitrile, 6 g MgSO₄ and 1 g NaCl, homogenize immediately, then centrifuge for 5 min at 300 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 5 g sample into a 50 mL centrifuge tube

steps.title: QuEChERS: Transfer to cleanup
steps.instruction: Transfer 2 mL of the supernatant to a clean 15 mL centrifuge tube containing 50 mg C18, 50 mg PSA, and 150 mg MgSO₄, vortex, then centrifuge for 5 min at 3000 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 2 mL supernatant into a 15 mL tube

steps.title: QuEChERS: Filter for LC‑MS
steps.instruction: Filter the resulting supernatant through a PTFE 13 mm × 0.22 µm filter directly into autosampler vials for LC‑MS analysis.

steps.title: Solvent: Homogenize bees
steps.instruction: Weigh 5 g honey bees, pound thoroughly in a glass mortar, transfer to a 250 mL flask and vigorously mix with 20 mL acetone for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Pound thoroughly in a glass mortar

steps.title: Solvent: Filter through Celite
steps.instruction: Filter the mixture in a Kitassato flask through a 13 cm Buchner funnel fitted with a paper filter packed with a 5–10 mm layer of Celite 545, washing the filter cake with an additional 20 mL acetone.

substeps.instruction: Set up Kitassato flask with 13 cm Buchner funnel
Place paper filter and pack with 5–10 mm Celite 545 layer
Wash filter cake with 20 mL acetone

steps.title: Solvent: Buffer addition
steps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL solution containing 1 % w/v ammonium chloride and 2 % v/v orthophosphoric acid (85 %), add it to the filtrate, stir occasionally, and let stand for 30 min before filtering again through Celite 545.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 100 mL buffer with 1 % w/v NH₄Cl and 2 % v/v H₃PO₄ (85 %)

steps.title: Solvent: Dichloromethane extraction
steps.instruction: Dilute the filtered sample with 200 mL of 2 % w/v aqueous sodium chloride, then extract twice with 100 mL dichloromethane each time.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 mL of 2 % w/v aqueous NaCl to the filtrate
Extract with another 100 mL dichloromethane (second extraction)

steps.title: Solvent: Dry organic phase
steps.instruction: Pass the combined dichloromethane extracts through a filter containing anhydrous sodium sulfate and evaporate to dryness in a rotary evaporator set at 35 °C.

substeps.instruction: Filter combined extracts through anhydrous Na₂SO₄
Evaporate to dryness in rotary evaporator at 35 °C

steps.title: Solvent: Final dissolution
steps.instruction: For GC analysis, dissolve the residue in acetone up to 2 mL; for LC‑MS, evaporate a 1‑mL aliquot to dryness under a gentle nitrogen stream and reconstitute in 1 mL methanol.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve residue in acetone up to 2 mL for GC
Evaporate 1 mL aliquot to dryness under nitrogen for LC‑MS
Reconstitute the dried LC‑MS aliquot in 1 mL methanol

steps.title: SPE: Hot‑water extraction
steps.instruction: Weigh 1.5 g honey, add 30 mL hot water (<80 °C), and agitate with a stir bar for 10 min.

substeps.instruction: Agitate with stir bar for 10 min

steps.title: SPE: Cartridge conditioning
steps.instruction: Condition an Oasis HLB cartridge with 5 mL methanol followed by 5 mL Milli‑Q water.

substeps.instruction: Pass 5 mL methanol through the cartridge
Pass 5 mL Milli‑Q water through the cartridge

steps.title: SPE: Load sample
steps.instruction: Pass the honey‑water mixture through the conditioned cartridge at a flow rate of 10 mL min⁻¹.

substeps.instruction: Load mixture onto cartridge at 10 mL min⁻¹

steps.title: SPE: Rinse cartridge
steps.instruction: Rinse the cartridge with 5 mL Milli‑Q water.

substeps.instruction: Pass 5 mL Milli‑Q water through the cartridge

steps.title: SPE: Vacuum dry
steps.instruction: Dry the cartridge under vacuum for 15 min.

steps.title: SPE: Elute pesticides
steps.instruction: Elute retained pesticides by passing 10 mL methanol–dichloromethane (3:7) through the cartridge.

steps.title: SPE: Evaporate eluate
steps.instruction: Evaporate the eluate to 0.5 mL using a gentle stream of nitrogen.

steps.title: SPE: Reconstitute extract
steps.instruction: Transfer the concentrate to a 1‑mL volumetric flask and fill to volume with methanol, yielding a final extract in 100 % methanol.

substeps.instruction: Add methanol to the mark (100 % methanol final)
